adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code now unconditionally performs a refresh-token request (`fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token" ...)`) and then writes the refreshed token into the DB via `prisma.credential.update(...)` before creating the `jsforce.Connection`. There is no check of token validity/expiry before doing this, so construction/connection setup is coupled to network + DB side effects and will happen even if the existing access token is still usable. The diff doesn’t clearly show this is literally inside the class constructor, but it is clearly eager in the connection initialization path shown.
